source.title: Amplitude estimation from quantum signal processing
source.version_actually_consulted: Final publisher-hosted PDF, acceptance stamp 20 February 2023; its title page includes arXiv:2207.08628v3 dated 27 February 2023. Publication information matches the retained final-source ledger.
source.fresh_consultation: Safari PDF accessibility text, printed pages28–32. I examined Empirical Claim 18, equation (69), Figure 5, the full ChebAE algorithm and equation (70), find_next_cheb, the confidence explanation, source code link and reported empirical query fits. Earlier reading of Section 1.1 is recorded in qsp_source_ledger.md; I do not present it as newly reread.
source.technical_use: Chebyshev sampling architecture, monotone-degree selection and probability-versus-amplitude distinction. Repeated looks receive separate confidence spending in the new bounded adaptation; empirical averages do not supply complete worst-history costs.
source.changes_from_published_controller: A proved two-sided financial probability prior, fresh fixed 100-shot batches without pooling, maximum 12 adaptive confidence looks, degree cap 2,047, explicit logical T pilotbudget and canonical QPE fallback. Both polynomial parities retain their correct success events. This is a bounded adaptation, not an unchanged reproduction of the published ChebAE controller.
